newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -T-bonds to rail against 115-23 resistance.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -T-bonds to rail against 115-23 resistance.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were expected to bang against resistance at 115-23 on Thursday, but may lack the momentum to smash through to the next major target at 116-12, technical analysts said.
T-bond futures set a high of 115-23 on Wednesday, but the momentum tailed off and the market lost most of its gains to close at 115-12.
"The market made that whole big move from July 22, but just hasn't backed it up," said Mike Macdonald, technical analyst at 4CAST in London. "It suggests the move was reactive rather than impulsive."
September T-bonds rallied from a low of 113-30 on July 22 to the 115-23 high. By 1000 GMT, they were unchanged in automated trade at 115-12.
If the market broke above 115-23, Macdonald said the next target was a Fibonacci projection of the move from 113-09 on February 18 down to 105-30 on April 11, which comes in at 116-03.
Andy Anderson, manager of strategic trading at Fuji Bank was more bullish, saying the market would aim for 116-12 on the upside. That was the December 4 1996 high on the continuation chart.

He said downmoves this session would be supported around 115-00. An intraday spike from July 17 will give some support at 115-02, while a move through the figure will hit support at congestion around 114-24.
At the short end, December Eurodollars were unchanged at 94.135.
